title: Stripped (Redone) Chests
description: Minecraft Chests redone with the Stripped Log texture
body:
I've always thought it was strange the Chest was just skipped in the texture update. But I've also never been in love with anyone eles takes on the chest texture ([This one's pretty good tho!](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/new-chests)) and I could never quite understand what the the chest was supposed to be. It's clearly wood but the texture is pretty ambiguous. 

This pack also matches all the chests in boats with their respective wood type:

<summary>Spoiler</summary>

![Chest boats!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0a72d874d38f750862d5a460aaaebdfc50a41eca.png)
